item.title: 曝苹果明年上半年将更新三款 iPad，Air 拟换 OLED 屏
item.guid: 曝苹果明年上半年将更新三款-iPad，Air-拟换-OLED-屏
item.description:
Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman revealed in the latest Power On that Apple plans to update the entry-level iPad, iPad Air, and iPad Pro in the first half of 2027. 彭博社记者 Mark Gurman 在最新一期 Power On 中透露，苹果计划在 2027 年上半年更新入门款 iPad、iPad Air 和 iPad Pro。

Among them, the iPad Air will switch to an OLED screen, aligning with the recently updated iPad mini; the iPad Pro will see performance improvements, with a significant change for high-end models potentially being the addition of a vapor chamber to improve heat dissipation during gaming and high-intensity AI tasks. The entry-level iPad will also receive an upgrade. 其中，iPad Air 将转向 OLED 屏幕，与刚更新的 iPad mini 看齐；iPad Pro 将提升性能，高端机型的重要变化可能是加入均热板，改善游戏和高强度 AI 任务中的散热。入门款 iPad 也将迎来升级。

Gurman stated that, according to the information he currently has, if the plans are not delayed, no major iPad updates are expected in the second half of next year. Gurman 表示，按他目前获得的信息，若计划没有推迟，明年下半年预计不会再有重大的 iPad 更新。

item.title: 我国首次载人登月乘组计划由 3 人组成，2 人着陆月球
item.guid: 我国首次载人登月乘组计划由-3-人组成，2-人着陆月球
item.description:
On October 31, Wang Xiang, deputy chief designer of China's manned space engineering project and chief designer of the lunar exploration project, introduced at the 7th Manned Space Academic Conference that China's first manned lunar exploration mission crew is planned to consist of 3 people, with 2 of them landing on the lunar surface. 10 月 31 日，中国载人航天工程副总设计师兼月球探测工程总设计师王翔在第七届载人航天学术大会上介绍，我国首次载人月球探测任务乘组计划由 3 人组成，其中 2 人着陆月球表面。

According to an on-site report by a Global Times reporter, China plans to achieve a Chinese landing on the moon before 2030, adopting a "two launches, one moon landing" lunar orbit rendezvous scheme: first, a Long March 10 carrier rocket will send a lander to lunar orbit, then a manned spacecraft will be launched to rendezvous and dock with the lander. After astronauts enter the lander, they will separate from the manned spacecraft and land on the lunar surface to carry out scientific exploration. 据《环球时报》记者现场报道，我国计划在 2030 年前实现中国人登陆月球，采用「两次发射，一次登月」的环月轨道对接方案：先用一枚长征十号运载火箭将着陆器送往月球轨道，再发射载人飞船，与着陆器交会对接。航天员进入着陆器后，与载人飞船分离并着陆月面，开展科学探测。

After completing the lunar surface mission, the astronauts will ascend in the lander, rendezvous and dock with the manned spacecraft again in lunar orbit, and then return to Earth aboard the manned spacecraft. 月面任务完成后，航天员将乘着陆器上升，在月球轨道与载人飞船再次交会对接，随后乘载人飞船返回地球。

item.title: ChatGPT 与 Codex 将从 12 月起共享额度，Instant 聊天不扣额度
item.guid: ChatGPT-与-Codex-将从-12-月起共享额度，Instant-聊天不扣额度
item.description:
OpenAI updated its help center to state that, starting in December, usage quotas for Plus, Pro, and Business plans in ChatGPT and Codex will be combined. This adjustment is related to the integration of ChatGPT Work's agent capabilities into ChatGPT. OpenAI 更新帮助中心说明，计划从 12 月起，将 Plus、Pro 和 Business 套餐在 ChatGPT 与 Codex 中的使用额度合并计算。这项调整与 ChatGPT Work 的智能体能力并入 ChatGPT 有关。

Both services will measure usage uniformly by tokens, with consumption depending on the selected model and task complexity: stronger models and complex tasks typically consume more quota, while Instant chat does not use this portion of the quota. 两项服务将按 token 统一衡量用量，消耗取决于所选模型和任务复杂度：更强的模型、复杂任务通常会消耗更多额度，Instant 即时聊天不占用这部分额度。

The combined remaining quota and reset time will be displayed in "Settings → Usage". Once exhausted, users can wait for a reset, upgrade their plan, or purchase credits to continue using eligible features. 合并后的剩余额度与重置时间将显示在「设置 → 使用量」中。用完后，用户可等待重置、升级套餐，或购买积分继续使用符合条件的功能。

🔗 Related reading: ChatGPT and Codex to share quotas, ending the era of free resets 🔗 相关阅读： ChatGPT要和Codex共用额度，免费重置时代结束了

item.title: 多家车企公布 10 月成绩单
item.guid: 多家车企公布-10-月成绩单
item.description:
Multiple car manufacturers announced October sales or delivery data. Leapmotor delivered over 100,000 vehicles for four consecutive months, Nio's three brands combined delivered 34,246 vehicles; SAIC Group's vehicle sales decreased year-on-year, while new energy vehicles and overseas business continued to grow. 多家车企公布 10 月销量或交付数据。零跑连续四个月交付超过 10 万辆，蔚来三品牌合计交付 34,246 辆；上汽集团整车销量同比下降，新能源汽车与海外业务继续增长。

    Leapmotor : Global deliveries reached 106,127 vehicles, with monthly deliveries exceeding 100,000 for four consecutive months, and cumulative global deliveries surpassing 1.9 million vehicles. The company stated that the new Lafa5 will debut at the Guangzhou Auto Show in November.

    Nio Inc. : Delivered 34,246 vehicles, including 18,125 Nio brand vehicles, 8,383 Ledao vehicles, and 7,738 Firefly vehicles. Cumulative deliveries for the first ten months of this year reached 334,547 vehicles, a year-on-year increase of 38.5%.

    Li Auto : Delivered 29,025 vehicles, including over 3,000 units of the new MEGA. Li Auto announced that OTA 9.2 will begin rolling out in November, upgrading MACH VLA 2.5 and cockpit Agent functions.

    SAIC Group : According to production and sales announcements cited by China Fund News and Gelonghui, October vehicle sales were 430,000 units, a year-on-year decrease of 5.28%; among them, new energy vehicle sales were 258,600 units, a year-on-year increase of 25.12%, and exports and overseas base sales were 162,500 units, a year-on-year increase of 67.28%.

    BYD : New energy vehicle sales were approximately 490,200 units, a year-on-year increase of 10.97%; among them, pure electric vehicles were approximately 305,700 units, plug-in hybrids were approximately 177,400 units, and new energy vehicle exports were approximately 170,200 units.

    Geely Auto : Total sales were 310,183 units, a year-on-year increase of approximately 1%; pure electric vehicles were 140,758 units, plug-in hybrids were 74,238 units, and exports were 107,153 units.

    Great Wall Motor : Sales were 120,374 units, a year-on-year decrease of 15.87%; among them, new energy vehicles were 49,499 units, and overseas sales were 62,862 units.

    Xiaomi Auto : Delivered over 50,000 vehicles.

    Harmony Intelligent Mobility Alliance (HIMA) : Delivered 33,537 vehicles, with cumulative deliveries exceeding 1.6 million units.

    Zeekr : Brand deliveries reached 32,483 vehicles, a year-on-year increase of 51.6%.

    Deepal Auto : Global sales were 32,602 units, a month-on-month increase of 8.01%.

    Changan Qiyuan : Global sales were 63,648 units, a month-on-month increase of 22.24%; Qiyuan Q06 achieved sales of 10,152 units in its first full month on the market.

    Hyper Aion BU : Sales were 42,357 units, a year-on-year increase of 56.79%.

    Voyah Auto : Delivered 13,030 vehicles, with cumulative deliveries for the first ten months of this year increasing by 13% year-on-year.

    BAIC New Energy : Sales were 32,502 units, a year-on-year increase of 6.42%.

    Seres Group : Vehicle sales were 27,037 units, a year-on-year decrease of 50.29%; among them, new energy vehicle sales were 24,921 units.

item.title: 奥特曼与三星约 50 名高管座谈，讨论 AI 未来十年的商业应用
item.guid: 奥特曼与三星约-50-名高管座谈，讨论-AI-未来十年的商业应用
item.description:
On October 31, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman was invited to Samsung Human Resources Development Institute in Yongin, South Korea, where he held a discussion with about 50 executives from Samsung Electronics, finance, biopharmaceuticals, and other businesses. Samsung introduced to Korean media that the theme of this event was "The Next Decade AI Will Change: Choices for Enterprises," discussing technological evolution, industrial applications, and new market opportunities. 10 月 31 日，OpenAI CEO 萨姆·奥特曼受邀来到韩国龙仁的三星人力开发院，与三星电子、金融、生物医药等业务约 50 名高管举行座谈。三星向韩国媒体介绍，本次主题为「AI 将改变的未来十年：企业的选择」，讨论技术演进、产业应用和新市场机会。

According to reports from "Maeil Business Newspaper," before the discussion, executives also received hands-on generative AI training, learning to organize scattered business data, build personal knowledge bases, and use them for decision-making. Samsung has been promoting an AI transformation covering R&D, production, marketing, and support departments since June, planning to extend executive training to general employees and complete company-wide AI training by February 2027. 据《每日经济新闻》报道，座谈前，高管还接受了生成式 AI 实操培训，学习整理分散的经营资料、建立个人知识库，并将其用于决策。三星自 6 月起推进覆盖研发、生产、营销和支持部门的 AI 转型，计划将高管培训扩展至普通员工，于 2027 年 2 月完成全员 AI 培训。

The two parties had previously collaborated on AI infrastructure: Samsung Electronics and OpenAI signed a letter of intent last October to advance memory chip supply for the Stargate project; Samsung SDS participated in AI data center and enterprise AI service cooperation, while Samsung C&T and Samsung Heavy Industries are jointly developing offshore floating data centers. 双方此前已在 AI 基础设施上展开合作：三星电子与 OpenAI 去年 10 月签署意向书，推进 Stargate 项目的存储芯片供应；三星 SDS 参与 AI 数据中心及企业 AI 服务合作，三星物产和三星重工则推进海上浮式数据中心的共同开发。

item.title: TCL 华星 t8 产线设备进场，计划明年底量产印刷 OLED
item.guid: TCL-华星-t8-产线设备进场，计划明年底量产印刷-OLED
item.description:
On October 31, TCL CSOT held the equipment move-in ceremony for its t8 project in Guangzhou. The first core process equipment entered the site, marking the transition of the production line from factory construction to equipment installation and debugging. This G8.6 printed OLED production line is planned for mass production in the fourth quarter of 2027. TCL 华星 10 月 31 日在广州举行 t8 项目设备搬入仪式，首台核心工艺设备进场，产线由厂房建设转入设备安装与调试阶段。这条 G8.6 印刷 OLED 产线计划于 2027 年第四季度量产。

According to TCL CSOT's project press release, t8 has a total investment of approximately 29.5 billion yuan, with a designed monthly processing capacity of about 22,500 glass substrates. It is primarily aimed at tablets, laptops, and monitors, and can also extend to flexible and foldable displays. Next, production line installation, power system joint debugging, and process verification will be carried out. 据 TCL 华星项目新闻稿，t8 总投资约 295 亿元，设计月加工玻璃基板能力约 2.25 万片，主要面向平板、笔记本电脑和显示器，也可延伸至柔性、折叠显示屏。接下来将开展产线安装、动力系统联调和工艺验证。

Printed OLED technology uses inkjet printing to deposit organic light-emitting materials onto glass substrates as needed. TCL CSOT states that, compared to vacuum evaporation, this approach can improve material utilization; the company previously achieved mass production of printed OLEDs on its G5.5 generation line at Wuhan t12. 印刷 OLED 通过喷墨打印，将有机发光材料按需沉积到玻璃基板上。TCL 华星称，相较真空蒸镀，这一路线能提高材料利用率；公司此前已在武汉 t12 的 G5.5 代线上实现印刷 OLED 量产。

item.title: AI 控制机械臂完成活鼠脑内注射，兽医负责开颅
item.guid: AI-控制机械臂完成活鼠脑内注射，兽医负责开颅
item.description:
Biotechnology company Exin Therapeutics integrated an AI agent into experimental equipment, allowing it to select gene therapies and control a robotic arm to perform intracerebral injections for an epileptic model mouse. Founder Gabriel Ocana Santero told WIRED that veterinarians first perform craniotomy, then the AI selects the therapy, brain region, and injection coordinates from 19 options in a table, and controls the injection volume and speed. 生物技术公司 Exin Therapeutics 将 AI 智能体接入实验设备，让它选择基因疗法并控制机械臂，为一只癫痫模型小鼠完成脑内注射。创始人 Gabriel Ocana Santero 向 WIRED 介绍，兽医先完成开颅，AI 再从表格中的 19 个选项选择疗法、脑区和注射坐标，并控制注射量与速度。

The team initially tested Claude Opus 5.5, which completed the experimental planning but refused to insert the needle into the mouse's brain; operations only continued after switching to Claude Sonnet 5. The team required human approval for injection plans, set up an emergency button to cut off the equipment's motor, and prohibited the agent from altering the equipment's underlying code. 团队最初测试 Claude Opus 5.5，它完成了实验规划，但拒绝将针头伸入小鼠大脑；换用 Claude Sonnet 5 后才继续操作。团队要求注射方案先由人类批准，并设置可切断设备电机的紧急按钮，同时禁止智能体改动设备底层代码。

During the process, the equipment's coordinate system malfunctioned. The agent identified an error in the injection position calculation but could not modify the code due to the aforementioned restrictions, so the team used another Opus 5 agent to fix it. The entire experiment took slightly over an hour, while conventional similar operations take about 45 minutes. Santero stated that the mouse recovered well, and the team is awaiting the gene therapy's effect before evaluating its impact on seizures. 过程中，设备坐标系统出现故障。智能体识别出注射位置计算有误，却因上述限制无法修改代码，团队另用一个 Opus 5 智能体修复。整场实验耗时略超一小时，常规同类操作约需 45 分钟。Santero 称小鼠恢复良好，团队正等待基因疗法起效，再评估对癫痫发作的影响。

🔗 Related reading: Claude performed brain surgery on a live mouse, but Opus 5.5 refused to act 🔗 相关阅读： Claude 给活鼠做了场脑部手术，Opus 5.5 却不肯动手

item.title: 西湖大学成立世界模型研究中心，计划三年内构建千亿参数模型
item.guid: 西湖大学成立世界模型研究中心，计划三年内构建千亿参数模型
item.description:
On October 31, the Westlake World Model Research Center was established at Westlake University, with Yu Kaicheng, Assistant Professor and PhD supervisor at the School of Engineering, serving as its director. This university-level interdisciplinary research platform will be tasked with building a general world model. Yu Kaicheng stated in an exclusive interview with Chao News that they plan to achieve a scale of 100 billion parameters within three years. 10 月 31 日，西湖世界模型研究中心在西湖大学成立，由工学院助理教授、博士生导师于开丞担任主任。这个校级交叉科研平台将以构建通用世界模型为使命，于开丞在接受潮新闻专访时表示，规划在三年内做到 1000 亿参数规模。

He used the analogy of picking up a cup to explain the concept of a world model: before reaching out, a machine first rehearses whether to pick it up from the front or the side, whether it will touch other objects, and then chooses the path with greater certainty. The model predicts the next state of the world to identify problems before acting; robotic operations and autonomous driving are application scenarios he cited. 他用拿杯子解释世界模型的思路：机器在伸手之前，先预演从正面还是侧面拿、会不会碰到其他物体，再选择把握更大的路径。模型预测的是世界的下一个状态，以便在行动前发现问题；机器人操作、自动驾驶等是他举出的应用场景。

Yu Kaicheng also emphasized that the number of parameters does not equate to capability; training data, architecture, training methods, and task focus are equally crucial, stressing the need to "do it right before making it big." The center plans to connect with various colleges at Westlake University for interdisciplinary cooperation and recruit talent globally. 于开丞同时强调，参数量不等于能力，训练数据、架构、训练方法与任务聚焦度同样关键，要「先做对，才能做大」。中心计划联通西湖大学各学院开展跨学科合作，并面向全球招引人才。

item.title: Claude Code 限制 Opus 5.5 复刻现有游戏，原创游戏仍可制作
item.guid: Claude-Code-限制-Opus-5.5-复刻现有游戏，原创游戏仍可制作
item.description:
Anthropic developer Addy Osmani confirmed that the team added two sentences to the prompt used with Claude Code when using Opus 5.5, guiding the model to avoid replicating a specific game by others. This is based on the premise that using Claude to infringe on intellectual property violates the company's usage policy. Anthropic 开发者 Addy Osmani 确认，团队在 Claude Code 使用 Opus 5.5 时的提示词中增加了两句话，引导模型避开复刻他人的某款特定游戏。其依据是，使用 Claude 侵犯知识产权违反公司的使用政策。

Osmani stated that original games, games of a certain genre, and games made with users' own designs and materials should continue to function normally. He also mentioned that the team will continuously iterate on the rules, and if the model refuses to process a user's own content, the case can be sent to him. Osmani 表示，原创游戏、某一类型的游戏，以及采用用户自有设计和素材制作的游戏，都应继续正常工作。他同时称团队会持续迭代规则，若模型拒绝处理用户自己的内容，可以把案例发给他。

This clarification responded to user doubts about Claude Code's new rules. The rules displayed by relevant users explicitly state that even if an existing game is renamed or claimed to be original, it should not be directly replicated. 这次说明回应了用户对 Claude Code 新规则的质疑。相关用户展示的规则写明，即使把现有游戏改名，或声称作品是原创，也不应直接复刻。

item.title: Claude Ultra 取消已验证账户的 5 小时限额，周额度仍保留
item.guid: Claude-Ultra-取消已验证账户的-5-小时限额，周额度仍保留
item.description:
Anthropic adjusted its Claude subscription plans, renaming the original Max 20x to Ultra and removing the 5-hour usage limit for verified Ultra accounts. Existing subscribers are automatically transferred to the new plan, and the web subscription price remains $200 per month. Anthropic 调整 Claude 订阅套餐，将原 Max 20x 更名为 Ultra，并取消已验证 Ultra 账户的 5 小时用量限制。原有订阅者自动转入新套餐，网页订阅价格仍为每月 200 美元。

According to the official help documentation, Ultra's weekly usage is 10 times that of Pro, with all models sharing a weekly quota, and Fable having a separate weekly limit. Users can arrange their usage pace within the weekly quota. 据官方帮助文档，Ultra 每周用量为 Pro 的 10 倍，所有模型共用周额度，Fable 另有独立的每周限制。用户可以在周额度内自行安排使用节奏。

Account verification is automatically completed by the system based on account and payment history. Unverified accounts temporarily retain restrictions, which are automatically lifted after verification; phone number verification during checkout is separate from this review. If the current session progress bar is not visible in "Settings — Usage," it means the account has been verified. 账户验证由系统依据账户和付款历史自动完成，尚未验证的账户暂时保留限制，验证后自动解除；结账时的手机号验证与这项审核分开。在「设置 — 用量」中看不到当前会话进度条，即表示账户已通过验证。

item.title: 黑石下调评级预期，预计 Anthropic 上市后或仍处「垃圾级」
item.guid: 黑石下调评级预期，预计-Anthropic-上市后或仍处「垃圾级」
item.description:
According to the Financial Times, Blackstone informed investors that it expects Anthropic to receive a double-B credit rating after its IPO, placing it in the higher tier of speculative-grade, commonly known as "junk" status. Blackstone had previously anticipated that the company would achieve an investment-grade rating before 2027. 据《金融时报》报道，黑石向投资者表示，预计 Anthropic 在 IPO 后将获得双 B 区间的信用评级，处于投机级、俗称「垃圾级」的较高档位。黑石此前曾预计，这家公司会在 2027 年之前获得投资级评级。

TechCrunch sought confirmation from Anthropic and Blackstone, but both declined to comment. Blackstone is a major investor in Anthropic's chip financing deal, and its change in judgment affects the AI company's subsequent financing conditions. TechCrunch 向 Anthropic 与黑石求证，双方均拒绝置评。黑石是 Anthropic 芯片融资交易的主要投资方，其判断变化涉及这家 AI 公司后续的融资条件。

If the rating remains speculative-grade, it will be more difficult for Anthropic to raise funds for its continuously expanding computing power expenditures, and costs may also be higher. 若评级停留在投机级，Anthropic 为持续扩大的算力支出筹资将更困难，成本也可能更高。

item.title: 奇瑞回应智界独立：希望团队更像新势力，明年将导入新产品
item.guid: 奇瑞回应智界独立：希望团队更像新势力，明年将导入新产品
item.description:
At the Q3 media communication meeting on October 31, Chery Automobile Executive Vice President Qi Shilong responded to the independent operation of Luxeed, stating that he hopes the Luxeed team will be more like a new energy vehicle startup and avoid becoming a "larger version" of a traditional car company. 在 10 月 31 日的三季度媒体沟通交流会上，奇瑞汽车执行副总裁戚士龙回应智界独立运营时表示，希望智界团队更像新势力企业，避免做成「大一号」的传统车企。

He stated that Chery will enhance Zhijie's independent operational capabilities by focusing on organizational scaling, product premiumization, and gradual brand optimization. According to Jiemian News, Zhijie will also introduce new products next year, and its overseas business will continue to be independently operated by the Chery Group. 他表示，奇瑞将从组织规模化、产品高端化及品牌逐步优化等方面，提升智界独立运营能力。据界面新闻报道，智界明年还会导入新产品，海外业务仍由奇瑞集团独立运营。

item.title: Grok API 将默认加入隐形文本水印，团队可按模型关闭
item.guid: Grok-API-将默认加入隐形文本水印，团队可按模型关闭
item.description:
Grok development documentation has been released. Starting November 7, API text output from Grok 4.7, 4.6, 4.5, 4.3, and three Grok 4.20 models will default to including invisible watermarks, covering global and regional endpoints. Team administrators can disable watermarks by model in the console. Grok 开发文档公布，11 月 7 日起，Grok 4.7、4.6、4.5、4.3 及三款 Grok 4.20 模型的 API 文本输出将默认加入隐形水印，覆盖全球及区域端点。团队管理员可在控制台按模型关闭水印。

Watermarks fine-tune token selection during generation, without adding hidden characters or tags to replies. Plain text, structured output, and tool call parameters are all covered. Developers do not need to modify requests and can check if the output contains a watermark via the x-watermark header in the response. 水印在生成过程中微调 Token 的选择，不向回复添加隐藏字符或标记，普通文本、结构化输出和工具调用参数都在覆盖范围内。开发者无需修改请求，可通过响应中的 x-watermark 标头查看该次输出是否带水印。

The official statement claims this move is to comply with the EU AI Act. Detection uses statistical methods; the longer the text, the stronger the signal. A separate application for usage permission is required for the detection API. 官方称，此举是为遵守欧盟《人工智能法案》。检测采用统计方法，文本越长，信号越强；检测 API 需另行申请使用权限。

item.title: 小鹏 MONA 明年将在部分城市开独立门店
item.guid: 小鹏-MONA-明年将在部分城市开独立门店
item.description:
According to Jiemian News, Xiaopeng Group President Wang Fengying stated during the Paris Motor Show that starting in 2027, some cities will establish independent MONA stores, and in the future, "the possibility of the MONA brand becoming independent is not ruled out." 据界面新闻报道，小鹏集团总裁王凤英在巴黎车展期间表示，从 2027 年开始，部分城市将设立 MONA 独立门店，未来也「不排除 MONA 品牌独立的可能性」。

Preparatory actions have already appeared on the channel side. A sales person at a Xiaopeng store in Beijing told Jiemian News that Xiaopeng and MONA are expected to be sold separately; He Lei, CEO of New Travel, found that a "Xiaopeng MONA Sales Center" is awaiting occupancy in a shopping mall in Haizhu District, Guangzhou. 渠道端已经出现筹备动作。北京一家小鹏门店销售人员向界面新闻表示，小鹏和 MONA 预计会分开销售；新出行 CEO 贺磊则发现，广州海珠区一家商场出现待入驻的「小鹏 MONA 销售中心」。

Product planning is also being adjusted. Jiemian News learned that Xiaopeng recently merged its original four product lines into two, G and D, with MONA continuing to exclusively use the D product line. He Lei stated that next year, only a portion of channels will become independent MONA channels, and existing Xiaopeng stores will still sell MONA models. 产品规划也在调整。界面新闻获悉，小鹏近期把原有四条产品线合并为 G、D 两条，MONA 继续独享 D 产品线。贺磊称，明年仅一部分渠道会成为 MONA 独立渠道，现有小鹏门店仍会销售 MONA 车型。

item.title: TBC 把神经元研究用进视频模型，称生成速度至少提高 5 倍
item.guid: TBC-把神经元研究用进视频模型，称生成速度至少提高-5-倍
item.description:
The Biological Computing Co. (TBC) has released its image-to-video model, Mischief 1. Company CEO Alex Ksendzovsky stated that the team has transformed four years of research on living neurons into a video model available for external use, with generation speeds at least 5 times faster than foundational models. The Biological Computing Co.（TBC）发布图生视频模型 Mischief 1。公司 CEO Alex Ksendzovsky 表示，团队把持续四年的活神经元研究转化成了可供外部使用的视频模型，生成速度至少达到基础模型的 5 倍。

He confirmed in his reply that Mischief 1 is based on Alibaba's open-source model Wan 2.2, and the next-generation model is also under development. The neurons used in the research remain in the lab, while the video model runs on ordinary chips. 他在回复中确认，Mischief 1 基于阿里开源模型 Wan 2.2，下一代模型也已在开发。研究中使用的神经元留在实验室，视频模型运行在普通芯片上。

Mischief 1 is now available on fal and OpenRouter, supporting the generation of short videos from images. Ksendzovsky also announced that the model will be available on AWS Marketplace. Mischief 1 已在 fal 和 OpenRouter 提供服务，支持以图片生成短视频。Ksendzovsky 还预告，模型将进入 AWS Marketplace。

item.title: 长鑫称已与头部客户协商长协，预计四季度营收继续增长
item.guid: 长鑫称已与头部客户协商长协，预计四季度营收继续增长
item.description:
Changxin Technology responded to the progress of long-term supply agreements in its investor relations activity record disclosed on October 31, stating that it has negotiated long-term agreements with several leading customers to lock in mid-to-long-term certain demand. 长鑫科技在 10 月 31 日披露的投资者关系活动记录中回应长期供货协议进展，称已与多家头部客户协商长协，以锁定中长期确定性需求。

According to China Newsweek's report on the record sheet, the company believes that AI applications are driving structural demand growth, server customer demand remains strong in the fourth quarter, and the tight supply of DRAM will continue, with fourth-quarter revenue expected to maintain growth. 据中新经纬对记录表的报道，公司认为 AI 应用正在推动结构性需求增长，服务器客户第四季度需求仍强劲，DRAM 供不应求的态势将延续，预计第四季度营收继续保持增长。

The company also explained that Changxin Xinqiao and Changxin Jidian were the main drivers of revenue and profit growth in the third quarter, but the group's equity ratio in the two subsidiaries was relatively low, thus affecting the growth rate at the parent company level. The company increased its capital injection into Changxin Jidian and raised its equity ratio in August this year. 公司还解释，长鑫新桥与长鑫集电是第三季度营收和利润增长的主要驱动力，但集团在两家子公司的权益比例相对较低，因此归母层面的增长幅度受到影响。公司已在今年 8 月增加对长鑫集电的注资、提高权益比例。

item.title: 💡 DeepSeek Harness 团队：多任务 Agent 的瓶颈在人的注意力
item.guid: 💡-DeepSeek-Harness-团队：多任务-Agent-的瓶颈在人的注意力
item.description:
The DeepSeek Harness team published a lengthy article on October 31 exploring the Super-agent architecture, pointing out that as models become increasingly capable of independently completing individual tasks, the bottleneck in multi-task collaboration is shifting to human attention. The team observed that an individual can usually only follow 3 to 5 active conversations, thus hoping for the system to take over conversation management, allowing users to focus on decision-making and acceptance. DeepSeek Harness 团队 10 月 31 日发表 Super-agent 架构探索长文，指出随着模型越来越能独立完成单个任务，多任务协作的瓶颈正在转向人的注意力。团队观察到，一个人通常只能跟进 3 至 5 个活跃会话，因此希望由系统接管会话管理，让用户专注于决策与验收。

The team's solution divides responsibilities into two layers: a persistent Router responsible for cross-task coordination and external interaction, and context-isolated Workers concurrently executing specific tasks. Subsequent messages for the same GitHub PR or group chat topic can be directly delivered to the corresponding Worker, reducing repeated routing; time-consuming tools run in the background, while the foreground continues to accept new instructions. 团队的方案是将职责分成两层：常驻的 Router 负责跨任务协调与对外交互，上下文隔离的 Worker 并发执行具体任务。同一 GitHub PR 或群聊话题的后续消息可直接送达对应 Worker，减少反复路由；耗时工具在后台运行，前台继续接受新指令。

The article introduces that internal instances can continuously advance tasks between IM and GitHub, and identify defects, attempt fixes, and submit PRs even when no one is @-mentioned in group chats. To maintain long-term operation, the team also separated computation, session state, and execution environment, and used an independent Watchdog to check whether tasks are making substantial progress. 文章介绍，内部实例已能在 IM 与 GitHub 之间连续推进任务，并在群聊无人 @ 的情况下识别缺陷、尝试修复后提交 PR。为维持长期运行，团队还把计算、会话状态与执行环境分开，并用独立的 Watchdog 检查任务是否取得实质进展。

The team emphasizes that this is an engineering architecture exploration, with some designs provided as the dsh-superagent-prototype, and not yet a formal product. Its preliminary experiments used synthetic loads and simplified environments; context isolation in larger organizations, cross-Agent collaboration, and prompt injection and credential leakage risks are still listed as open problems by the team. 团队强调，这是一套工程架构探索，部分设计以 dsh-superagent-prototype 原型提供，尚非正式产品。其初步实验采用合成负载与简化环境；更大组织中的上下文隔离、跨 Agent 协作，以及提示词注入与凭据泄露风险，仍是团队列出的开放问题。

🔗 Related reading: DeepSeek's Major Release of a New Agent Architecture: AI Begins Directing AI Work 🔗 相关阅读： DeepSeek 重磅发布全新 Agent 架构：AI 开始指挥 AI 干活

item.title: HomeView 代码出现安防摄像头模式，可按在家、外出和睡眠设置录制
item.guid: HomeView-代码出现安防摄像头模式，可按在家、外出和睡眠设置录制
item.description:
Apple's HomeView smart home hub may add security camera features. The Verge reported that Reddit user pdfu found related strings in the HomeView 27.2 code, with one settings page stating that HomeView can be used as a security camera via HomeKit Secure Video. 苹果 HomeView 智能家居中枢可能增加安防摄像头功能。The Verge 报道，Reddit 用户 pdfu 在 HomeView 27.2 代码中发现相关字符串，其中一个设置页面写明，HomeView 可通过 HomeKit Secure Video 用作安防摄像头。

The features described in the code include motion detection, live video, and recording. Videos are only viewable by family members; when someone views the footage or the device starts recording, the device will light up an indicator and play a sound, and changes to Secure Video settings will also notify family members. 代码描述的功能包括移动侦测、实时视频和录制。视频仅供家庭成员查看；有人查看画面或设备开始录制时，设备会亮起指示灯并播放声音，Secure Video 设置改变也会通知家庭成员。

Users can also set detection, streaming, and recording content separately based on their home, away, or sleep status. The above information comes from code clues, and Apple has not yet announced this feature. 用户还可根据在家、外出或睡眠状态，分别设置侦测、串流和录制内容。上述信息来自代码线索，苹果尚未宣布这项功能。

item.title: ChatGPT 网页和手机端支持双账号切换，聊天与记忆各自独立
item.guid: ChatGPT-网页和手机端支持双账号切换，聊天与记忆各自独立
item.description:
OpenAI has launched an account switching feature on ChatGPT web, iOS, and Android. Users can log in to a maximum of two accounts simultaneously and switch between them from the account menu or settings, without repeatedly logging out and logging in again; only one account is active at a time. The mobile feature is being gradually rolled out. OpenAI 已在 ChatGPT 网页端、iOS 和 Android 推出账号切换功能。用户可同时登录最多两个账号，从账号菜单或设置中切换，无需反复退出再登录；同一时间只有一个账号处于活跃状态。移动端功能正逐步开放。

OpenAI's help documentation states that after switching, the corresponding account's chats, memories, files, and settings are displayed, and workspaces also belong to their respective accounts. The two accounts will not merge conversations, subscriptions, bills, or workspaces, and paid benefits are still determined by each account's own subscription. OpenAI 的帮助文档说明，切换后显示的是对应账号的聊天、记忆、文件和设置，工作区也归属于各自账号。两个账号不会合并对话、订阅、账单或工作区，付费权益仍由各账号自己的订阅决定。

Users can have more than two ChatGPT accounts, but a maximum of two accounts can be logged in simultaneously on the same device; if two are already logged in, one must be logged out before adding another account. The mobile app can also receive notifications according to each account's settings and device permissions, and clicking a notification from another account will switch to and open the corresponding content. 用户可以拥有两个以上的 ChatGPT 账号，但同一设备最多同时保持两个账号登录；已登录两个时，需先退出其中一个才能添加其他账号。移动端还可依照各账号设置和设备权限接收通知，点击另一账号的通知时会切换并打开对应内容。

item.title: 分析师预测《GTA6》PC 版还需约 6 至 7 个月
item.guid: 分析师预测《GTA6》PC-版还需约-6-至-7-个月
item.description:
Wedbush analyst Michael Pachter predicted on BBC Business Today that 'GTA6' would take approximately 6 to 7 more months to arrive on PC. Related interview clips circulated on social media on October 28. Wedbush 分析师迈克尔·帕赫特在 BBC Business Today 节目中预测，《GTA6》大约还需 6 至 7 个月登陆 PC。相关采访片段于 10 月 28 日在社交平台流传。

Rockstar announced the release date for the console version as November 19, 2026, with PS5 and Xbox Series X|S as the launch platforms. Pachter's statement is his own time estimate; Rockstar has not yet announced the PC version's release date. Rockstar 为主机版公布的发售日是 2026 年 11 月 19 日，首发平台为 PS5 和 Xbox Series X|S。帕赫特给出的是自己的时间判断，Rockstar 尚未公布 PC 版发售日。

item.title: 高通更新骁龙 X 显卡驱动，分代改进游戏稳定性
item.guid: 高通更新骁龙-X-显卡驱动，分代改进游戏稳定性
item.description:
Qualcomm has released the Adreno 2026.10.1 driver for Snapdragon X series Windows PCs. The update introduces an installation framework that simultaneously supports the original Snapdragon X and Snapdragon X2, with each generation having independent driver versions and improvement lists. 高通发布适用于骁龙 X 系列 Windows PC 的 Adreno 2026.10.1 驱动，更新引入同时支持初代骁龙 X 与骁龙 X2 的安装框架，两代平台各有独立的驱动版本和改进清单。

Updates for the original Snapdragon X involve stability or graphics quality for 'Naraka: Bladepoint', 'Red Dead Redemption 2', and 'RoboCop: Rogue City'; improvements for Snapdragon X2 include 'Forza Horizon 6', 'Grand Theft Auto V Legacy Edition', 'NBA 2K26', and more. Both generations list stability and performance improvements for applications like Luminar Neo. 初代骁龙 X 的更新涉及《永劫无间》《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》和《机械战警：暴戾都市》的稳定性或画质；骁龙 X2 的改进则包括《极限竞速：地平线 6》《侠盗猎车手 5 传承版》《NBA 2K26》等。两代平台均列出 Luminar Neo 等应用的稳定性和性能改进。

The official notes also retain a known Windows 11 issue: in Build 26100.3915 and later, plugging/unplugging external displays or switching display modes/resolutions may cause 'Metro Exodus', 'Civilization VI', and 'Left 4 Dead 2' to crash or freeze. 官方说明还保留一项 Windows 11 已知问题：在 Build 26100.3915 及更高版本中，插拔外接显示器或切换显示模式、分辨率，可能导致《地铁：离去》《文明 VI》《求生之路 2》崩溃或卡死。

item.title: Spotify 拟明年初推出 AI 混音，让歌迷改编已授权歌曲
item.guid: Spotify-拟明年初推出-AI-混音，让歌迷改编已授权歌曲
item.description:
According to the Financial Times, Spotify is aiming to launch an AI remix and cover service in the first quarter of 2027, possibly debuting around the Grammy Awards in February. Paid subscribers can use it to adapt authorized songs, such as changing a ballad into a dance track, or creating versions where a singer covers other works. 据《金融时报》报道，Spotify 正争取在 2027 年第一季度推出 AI 混音与翻唱服务，可能在 2 月格莱美奖前后亮相。付费订阅用户可用它改编已获授权的歌曲，例如把民谣改成舞曲，或制作歌手翻唱其他作品的版本。

Spotify has reached agreements with Universal Music, independent label licensing agencies Merlin and Believe, and is still negotiating with Sony Music and Warner Music. Even if record companies sign on, musicians can decide for themselves whether to participate. Spotify 已与环球音乐、独立厂牌授权机构 Merlin 和 Believe 达成相关协议，仍在与索尼音乐、华纳音乐谈判。即使唱片公司签约，音乐人也可以自行决定是否参与。

Under the current plan, royalties generated from fan remixes will go to the original musicians. Spotify is also developing a complementary mechanism to allow these works to enter playlists and count their play counts towards the original song's chart performance. Sources say that the launch time and pricing are still under discussion. 按目前方案，粉丝混音产生的版税会流向原作音乐人。Spotify 还在开发配套机制，让这些作品进入播放列表，并把播放量计入原曲榜单成绩。消息人士称，上线时间和定价仍在讨论中。

item.title: Meta 与傅利叶造出人形机器人 Max，已着手开发第二版
item.guid: Meta-与傅利叶造出人形机器人-Max，已着手开发第二版
item.description:
According to The Information, Meta and Shanghai robotics company Fourier spent about three months building the humanoid robot prototype Max, and began developing the second version, Max 2, in September. A Meta spokesperson responded that the work with Fourier focuses on internal research and experimentation, and the company has no plans to sell these prototypes. 据 The Information 报道，Meta 与上海机器人公司傅利叶用约三个月造出人形机器人原型 Max，并于 9 月开始开发第二版 Max 2。Meta 发言人回应称，与傅利叶的工作聚焦内部研究和实验，公司没有出售这些原型的计划。

Max is about 1.5 meters tall and weighs 48 kilograms, equipped with NVIDIA Jetson Thor. It has a built-in speaker in its chest, a facial screen that can simulate expressions, and five-fingered hands capable of grasping small bottles and toys. Based on Fourier's hardware and experience from its first three generations of robots, Meta adjusted the body proportions, head, display screen, and cameras, and added components such as hands. Max 约高 1.5 米、重 48 公斤，搭载英伟达 Jetson Thor，胸部内置扬声器，面部屏幕可以模拟表情，五指手能抓起小瓶子和玩具。Meta 基于傅利叶前三代机器人的硬件与经验，调整了机身比例、头部、显示屏和摄像头，并增加双手等部件。

The report states that Meta's head of robotics products stayed at Fourier's Shanghai factory for nearly two months, and the prototype was demonstrated at an internal summit in late August. The second version will redesign the torso and hands, add a projector, and sensors to help with climbing stairs; internally, Meta views humanoid robots as the physical carriers for its Muse AI Agent to perform tasks such as household chores. 报道称，Meta 机器人产品负责人曾在傅利叶上海工厂驻留近两个月，原型于 8 月底在内部峰会上演示。第二版将重做躯干与双手，加入投影仪，以及帮助上下楼梯的传感器；Meta 内部将人形机器人视作其 Muse AI Agent 执行家务等任务的实体载体。

item.title: 开源安卓助手 Mika 可在后台操作 App，主屏仍能继续用
item.guid: 开源安卓助手-Mika-可在后台操作-App，主屏仍能继续用
item.description:
Independent developer Wang Zan has open-sourced Mika, an Android AI assistant. After users describe tasks in natural language, it can open apps, click, type, and scroll on a separate background screen, leaving the main screen available for the user. 独立开发者王赞开源了安卓 AI 助手 Mika。用户用自然语言交代任务后，它可以在独立的后台屏幕上打开 App、点击、输入和滚动，主屏幕仍留给用户使用。

The project demonstrates its use cases such as browsing and summarizing WeChat group chats in the background, sending messages to file transfer assistants, and filtering products in shopping apps. Mika operates applications by reading the interface, without requiring each app to provide additional interfaces; login, verification codes, and payment steps are handed back to the user. 项目展示了后台翻阅微信群聊并总结、向文件传输助手发消息，以及在购物 App 中筛选商品的用法。Mika 通过读取界面操作应用，不要求每个 App 额外提供接口；登录、验证码和付款等环节会交还用户。

Cross-app operations require Android 12 or a newer system, and wireless debugging pairing must be completed for first-time use. The project recommends Android 14 and above, where the virtual screen can have an independent input focus, reducing interference from background tasks on main screen input. Users can connect their own model API or log in via supported model service accounts; the project uses the Apache 2.0 license. 跨 App 操作要求 Android 12 或更新系统，首次使用需完成无线调试配对。项目推荐 Android 14 及以上版本，虚拟屏幕可拥有独立输入焦点，减少后台任务对主屏输入的干扰。用户可以接入自己的模型 API，也可通过支持的模型服务账号登录；项目采用 Apache 2.0 许可。

item.title: 小米澎程 N70 现车新增 3 年 0 息，定制新车继续提供低息方案
item.guid: 小米澎程-N70-现车新增-3-年-0-息，定制新车继续提供低息方案
item.description:
Xiaomi Auto announced November car purchase benefits. A limited number of existing Pengcheng N70 vehicles now offer a '3 years 0 interest' financial plan, while custom new cars provide '5 years low interest' or 'limited-time easy repayment'. Both types of benefits apply to orders placed from November 1st to November 30th at 24:00. 小米汽车公布 11 月购车权益，澎程 N70 的少量现车新增「3 年 0 息」金融方案，定制新车则提供「5 年低息」或「限时轻松还」。两类权益均适用于 11 月 1 日至 11 月 30 日 24 点前下定的订单。

    Limited existing stock of all Pengcheng N70 models : Down payment starting from 79,900 yuan, choose one from "3 years 0 interest", "5 years installment with 3 years 0 interest", or "6,000 yuan insurance subsidy".

    Pengcheng Full-Range Custom New Cars : Low-interest financing with down payments starting from 49,900 yuan, monthly payments from 2,932 yuan over 5 years. A "limited-time easy repayment" option is also available.

    SU7, YU7, and SU7 Ultra : A limited number of SU7 models and specific YU7 versions are available with options for "3 years 0 interest," "5-year installment with 3 years 0 interest," or "6,000 yuan insurance subsidy"; SU7 Ultra offers a limited-time "5 years 0 interest."

item.title: 泰国高山咖啡 Akha Ama 在东京开出第三家店
item.guid: 泰国高山咖啡-Akha-Ama-在东京开出第三家店
item.description:
Akha Ama Coffee, from the northern mountains of Thailand, has opened its third Japanese coffee shop in Tokyo's Meguro district. According to Nikkei Asia's report on October 31, the brand hopes to further penetrate the Japanese market with high-quality, sustainably grown Thai coffee beans. 来自泰国北部山区的 Akha Ama Coffee 在东京目黑区开出日本第三家咖啡店。据日经亚洲 10 月 31 日报道，品牌希望以高品质、可持续种植的泰国咖啡豆，进一步打开日本市场。

Founder Lee Ayu Chuepa is from the Akha ethnic group; "Akha Ama" means "Akha Mother" in their language. The brand was established in 2010, sourcing coffee beans from farmers in northern Thailand, including the founder's mother and sister. These beans are then processed, roasted, and supplied to stores in Chiang Mai and Tokyo. Farmers cultivate Arabica coffee at high altitudes, intercropping it with fruits, nuts, and other crops, employing an agroforestry approach. 创始人 Lee Ayu Chuepa 来自阿卡族，「Akha Ama」在族语中意为「阿卡母亲」。品牌创办于 2010 年，从泰北农户处采购咖啡豆，其中包括创始人的母亲和姐姐，再加工、烘焙，供应清迈和东京的门店。农户在高海拔种植阿拉比卡咖啡，并与水果、坚果等作物混种，采用农林复合种植方式。

The founder stated that the brand values quality and origin stories, and is improving quality by reducing the use of fertilizers and chemicals. Currently, about 90% of the coffee beans are sold in Thailand, with the remaining 10% exported to Japan. The brand opened its first Japanese store in Kagurazaka, Tokyo, in 2020, and a second one in 2024. 创始人表示，品牌重视品质和产地故事，正在通过减少化肥及化学品使用来提高品质。目前约九成咖啡豆在泰国销售，其余一成出口日本；品牌于 2020 年在东京神乐坂开出日本首店，2024 年再开第二家。

item.title: 教室照明新国标实施，新增频闪与采光均匀度要求
item.guid: 教室照明新国标实施，新增频闪与采光均匀度要求
item.description:
On November 1, the mandatory national standard "Sanitary Standard for Lighting and Illumination in Classrooms of Primary and Secondary Schools" officially came into effect, further refining the evaluation indicators for classroom daylighting and lamp illumination. 11 月 1 日，强制性国家标准《中小学校教室采光和照明卫生标准》正式实施，教室采光和灯具照明的评价指标进一步细化。

According to CCTV News, the new standard adds requirements such as daylight uniformity, full-window sunshine duration on the winter solstice, glass color transmittance index, and visible light transmittance ratio. It also incorporates flicker index and stroboscopic effect visibility into the indicators. Revisions have been made to daylighting direction, daylight factor, glare control, illumination color temperature, color rendering index, and measurement methods. 据央视新闻报道，新标准增加采光均匀度、冬至日满窗日照时间、玻璃颜色透射指数和可见光透射比等要求，也将闪变指数、频闪效应可视度纳入指标。采光方向、采光系数、眩光控制、照明色温、显色指数及测量方法均有修订。

Tian Lei, an ophthalmologist from Beijing Tongren Hospital affiliated with Capital Medical University, interviewed in the report, explained that even if a light source appears stable, the visual system may still constantly adapt to changes in light. Prolonged exposure to such flickering environments can easily lead to eye fatigue. 报道采访的首都医科大学附属北京同仁医院眼科医生田磊介绍，光源看起来稳定，视觉系统仍可能不断适应光线变化，长期处在这类频闪环境中容易出现眼睛疲劳。

item.title: 《Hidari》导演谈基努·里维斯加盟：看完木偶短片，一周后约了视频会
item.guid: 《Hidari》导演谈基努·里维斯加盟：看完木偶短片，一周后约了视频会
item.description:
Shinji Kawamura, director of the Japanese stop-motion animated feature film "Hidari," revealed at the Tokyo International Film Festival that after Keanu Reeves watched the project's teaser short, the team received a response in about a week, arranging a video call between both parties. The news of Reeves voicing the protagonist was announced in Cannes this May; this time, the director further elaborated on the invitation process and the progress of the feature film's preparation. 日本定格动画长片《Hidari》的导演川村真司在东京国际电影节透露，基努·里维斯看过项目先导短片后，团队约一周便收到回复，安排双方视频通话。里维斯为主角配音的消息已于今年 5 月在戛纳公布；这次导演进一步讲述了邀请过程和长片筹备进展。

Kawamura stated that the work is influenced by Akira Kurosawa's films. When creating the protagonist puppet, he hoped to combine the images of Toshiro Mifune and Reeves, and then make the character appear older. "Hidari" combines wood carving, stop-motion animation, and period drama. The team positions it as an action film and has previously showcased the project to overseas distributors with hand-carved puppets. 川村表示，作品受黑泽明电影影响，制作主角木偶时，他就希望将三船敏郎与里维斯的形象结合，再让角色显得更年长。《Hidari》采用木雕、定格动画与时代剧的组合，团队将它定位为动作片，并曾带着手工雕刻的木偶向海外发行商展示项目。

According to Variety's on-site report, the team self-funded and crowdfunded a concept short film about three years ago, which accumulated approximately 5.3 million views after being uploaded to YouTube. The feature film is currently still seeking subsidies and overseas distribution partnerships; the producer previously revealed that an American company had offered to cover the entire budget in exchange for all rights, but related negotiations have stalled. 据 Variety 现场报道，团队约三年前自筹资金并借助众筹拍摄概念短片，上传 YouTube 后累计获得约 530 万次观看。长片目前仍在寻求补助和海外发行合作；制作人此前透露，一家美国公司曾提出承担全部预算并换取全部版权，相关谈判已陷入停滞。

item.title: 《Godzilla Minus Zero》将于 11 月 3 日在日本上映，故事接续前作两年后
item.guid: 《Godzilla-Minus-Zero》将于-11-月-3-日在日本上映，故事接续前作两年后
item.description:
Takashi Yamazaki's sequel to "Godzilla -1.0," titled "Godzilla Minus Zero," will be released in Japan on November 3. Ryunosuke Kamiki and Minami Hamabe revealed at a Tokyo International Film Festival event that the new film continues the story of the Shikishima family, set approximately two years after the previous work, with the family, just having returned to normal life, once again facing the threat of Godzilla. 山崎贵执导的《哥斯拉 -1.0》续作《Godzilla Minus Zero》将于 11 月 3 日在日本上映。神木隆之介、滨边美波在东京国际电影节活动上透露，新片延续敷岛浩一家人的故事，时间设在前作约两年后，刚恢复日常生活的家庭再度面临哥斯拉的威胁。

The two lead actors continue to portray Koichi Shikishima and Noriko, with Sae Nagatani returning as Akiko. Ryunosuke Kamiki stated that Akiko, who primarily expressed herself through crying or single words in the previous film, now has full dialogue. 两位主演继续饰演敷岛浩一与典子，永谷咲也回归饰演明子。神木隆之介表示，上一部中主要以哭泣或单词表达的明子，这次有了完整对白。

According to Variety's on-site report, the creators had just returned to Japan from a premiere event in Los Angeles, where audiences had shouted the director's name on the red carpet. The new film is also the first Japanese movie to receive "Filmed for IMAX" certification. 据 Variety 现场报道，主创刚从洛杉矶首映活动返回日本，观众曾在红毯高喊导演的名字。新片也是首部获得「Filmed for IMAX」认证的日本电影。

item.title: 《银魂》导演谈重制吉原炎上篇：为新版重修 200 多个镜头
item.guid: 《银魂》导演谈重制吉原炎上篇：为新版重修-200-多个镜头
item.description:
The "Gintama" animated film "Yoshiwara in Flames" debuted at the Lucca Comics & Games festival in Italy. Director Naoya Ando and the producers revealed in a Variety interview that after the Japanese release in February this year, the team re-polished over 200 shots for the DVD release. 《银魂》动画电影《吉原炎上》在意大利卢卡漫画游戏展亮相。导演安藤尚也与制片人在 Variety 采访中透露，团队在今年 2 月日本上映的版本之后，借影碟发行的机会重新打磨了 200 多个镜头。

This film revisits popular chapters from the original work. Naoya Ando stated that to make the action scenes suitable for the big screen, the team used CinemaScope ultra-wide aspect ratio, utilized 3D technology to enhance camera movement and composition changes, and also produced a large amount of new music. Compared to the TV anime, the film truly depicts the burning of Yoshiwara. 这部电影重访原作中的人气篇章。安藤尚也表示，为了让动作场面适合大银幕，团队采用 CinemaScope 超宽画幅，并利用 3D 技术增加摄影机运动与构图变化，也制作了大量新音乐。相比电视动画，电影还真正呈现了吉原燃烧的场面。

Regarding the humor in "Gintama," he said the team assigned a director primarily responsible for the comedy segments; they hoped to let the characters naturally joke with each other, allowing the audience to hear and feel the fun. 谈到《银魂》的幽默，他说团队安排了一位导演主要负责喜剧部分；他们希望让角色自然地互相开玩笑，让观众听见并感受到趣味。
